walk_forward.description: Walk forwards: a real fly's recorded step in a tripod gait, two steps per second

walk_backward.description: Walk backwards: the recorded step played in reverse, tripod gait

turn_left.description: Turn left on the spot: right legs step forwards, left legs step backwards with a shorter stride

turn_right.description: Turn right on the spot: left legs step forwards, right legs step backwards with a shorter stride

groom_antennae.description: front legs sweep over the head and antennae
